name: liability_concentration
description: Sportsbook read tool (tenant-scoped). Returns the events carrying the most concentrated book liability for the caller's tenant: per (event, selection), total stake, total potential payout (the book's exposure if that selection wins), and bet count, ordered by exposure. Typed and enumerated — bounded parameters only, no caller-supplied SQL. tenant_id is the requested data scope (the Gateway governance layer authorizes whether the caller may select it).

tenant_id.description: Tenant whose data this operation is scoped to (requested data scope). The Gateway governance layer authorizes whether the caller may select it.

top_k.description: Number of highest-exposure (event, selection) rows to return, intended range 1..50 (default 10; upper bound capped server-side).

min_stake.description: Only report (event, selection) groups whose total stake is at least this (default 0).
